series.name: Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A wired-controller alarm codes (SMGB0136)
series.notes: SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136 rev.0, 10/2021) §10.2.2.1 Alarm codes of wired controller. High (official service manual). RUN lamp flash + LCD code + outdoor 7-segment. Numeric/hex alarm codes — separate from SET FREE file (different product lines).

title.ur: Indoor float switch ki protection

meaning.en: The indoor unit protection device opened because the float switch detected a high water level in the drain pan.
meaning.ur: Float switch ne drain pan mein paani zyada hone ki nishani di, is liye indoor unit ka protection device khul gaya

causes.en: Drain pipe clogged, blocked or routed with an up-slope so water cannot leave.
causes.ur: Drain pipe ruka hua, band ya upar ki taraf jhuka hua hai jis se paani nahi nikal raha

causes.en: Float switch faulty, contact failure or indoor PCB failure.
causes.ur: Float switch kharab, us ka contact kharab ya indoor PCB kharab

solutions.en: Clear the drain pan and pour water through the drain to prove it flows.
solutions.ur: Drain pan saaf kariye aur drain mein paani daal kar baahne ki tasdeeq kariye

solutions.en: Check float switch continuity and replace the switch, pump or PCB if faulty.
solutions.ur: Float switch ki continuity check karein aur kharab ho to switch, pump ya PCB badal dein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

notes.en: Same meaning as alarm 01 in the SET FREE / air365 series. Detail comes from troubleshooting flow 10.2.2.2 (float switch, drain pump, PCB checks).
notes.ur: Yeh SET FREE / air365 series ke alarm 01 jaisa hi meaning hai. Tafseel troubleshooting flowchart 10.2.2.2 se milti hai (float switch, drain pump, PCB checks).

codes.blinkPattern: RUN lamp flashes on the wired remote, code on the LCD; the same code also flashes on the outdoor PCB 7-segment display

title.en: Outdoor high pressure or compressor thermostat trip
title.ur: Outdoor high pressure ya compressor thermostat trip

meaning.en: The outdoor high pressure cut-out or the compressor overheat thermostat opened.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ka high pressure cut-out ya compressor ka overheat thermostat khul gaya

causes.en: Pressure switch activated by pipe clogging, excess refrigerant, inert gas in the circuit or a locked fan.
causes.ur: Pipe ke rukaav, zyada charge, circuit mein ghair faal gas ya fan ke jam hone se pressure switch on ho gaya

causes.en: Compressor thermostat tripped from high discharge temperature.
causes.ur: Discharge temperature zyada hone se compressor thermostat trip ho gaya

solutions.en: Reduce the heat load, clean the heat exchanger and check fan operation.
solutions.ur: Heat load kam karein, heat exchanger saaf karein aur fan ka kaam check karein

solutions.en: Measure discharge pressure and replace a faulty pressure switch after correcting the charge.
solutions.ur: Discharge pressure napen aur charge theek karne ke baad kharab pressure switch badal dein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

notes.en: Outdoor 7-segment table 10.2.1.1 lists the same 02 with leading causes PSH activation, locked motor and abnormal supply phase.
notes.ur: Outdoor 7-segment table 10.2.1.1 mein bhi same 02 likha hai, jiske leading causes PSH activation, locked motor aur abnormal supply phase hain.

codes.blinkPattern: RUN lamp flashes on the wired remote, code on the LCD; also on the outdoor PCB 7-segment display

title.ur: Dono units ki communication kharabi

meaning.en: Communication between indoor and outdoor units stayed abnormal beyond the detection window.
meaning.ur: Dono units ke darmiyan communication itni der tak kharab rahi ke usay detect hi nahi kiya ja sake

causes.en: Power failure or no supply to one of the units.
causes.ur: Kisi aik unit ki power failure ya us par supply nahi hai

causes.en: Short circuit between wires, blown fuse or faulty PCB.
causes.ur: Wires ke darmiyan short circuit, ura hua fuse ya kharab PCB

solutions.en: Measure voltage at both units and restore the supply.
solutions.ur: Dono units par voltage napen aur supply theek karein

solutions.en: Check the interconnect cable for shorts, replace fuses and repair or replace boards.
solutions.ur: Interconnect cable ko short ke liye check karein, fuses badlein aur board ki marammat ya tabadli karein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

notes.en: Manual states the alarm appears after 3 minutes of abnormal communication, or 30 seconds after a reset.
notes.ur: Manual ke mutabiq alarm abnormal communication ke 3 minute baad, ya reset ke 30 second baad aata hai.

codes.blinkPattern: RUN lamp flashes on the wired remote, code on the LCD; also on the outdoor PCB 7-segment display

title.en: Inverter PCB to outdoor PCB communication fault
title.ur: Inverter PCB se outdoor PCB ki communication kharabi

meaning.en: The outdoor main board and the inverter board stopped exchanging data.
meaning.ur: Outdoor main board aur inverter board ne aapas mein data lena band kar diya

causes.en: Loose connector, broken wire or blown fuse between the two boards.
causes.ur: Dono boards ke darmiyan dheela connector, tooti wire ya ura hua fuse

causes.en: Inverter PCB or outdoor PCB failure.
causes.ur: Inverter PCB ya outdoor PCB kharab hona

solutions.en: Reseat the connectors and inspect the harness for damage.
solutions.ur: Connectors dobara lagayein aur harness ki kharabi ke liye check karein

solutions.en: Replace the failed board after confirming the wiring is sound.
solutions.ur: Wiring salamat hone ki tasdeiq kar ke kharab board badal dein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

notes.en: Outdoor table 10.2.1.1 splits this into transmission between inverter PCB and RASC unit PCB.
notes.ur: Outdoor table 10.2.1.1 ise do hisson mein baant ti hai: inverter PCB aur RASC unit PCB ke darmiyan transmission.

title.ur: Power supply ki phase kharabi

meaning.en: A supply phase is missing or reversed on the outdoor unit.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit par supply ka koi phase ghaayab ya palat hua hai

causes.en: Incoming supply open-phase or wrongly sequenced.
causes.ur: Aane wali supply mein phase khuli hui hai ya tar ghalat hai

causes.en: Wiring or contactor fault feeding the outdoor unit.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit ko supply karne wali wiring ya contactor kharab hai

solutions.en: Measure all phase voltages and correct the incoming phase order.
solutions.ur: Tamam phase voltages napen aur aane wali phase ki tar theek karein

solutions.en: Have the supply verified by a licensed electrician before restarting.
solutions.ur: Dobara chalane se pehle supply ko licensed electrician se check karwa lein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

notes.en: Outdoor table 10.2.1.1 describes this as reception of an abnormal power-source phase detection code.
notes.ur: Outdoor table 10.2.1.1 ise abnormal power-source phase detection code ki reception ke tor par bayan karti hai.

title.ur: Inverter ki voltage ghair mamooli

meaning.en: Supply voltage to the inverter is too low or too high.
meaning.ur: Inverter ko milne wali supply voltage bohat kam ya bohat zyada hai

causes.en: Voltage drop in the mains supply.
causes.ur: Mains supply mein voltage drop

causes.en: Incorrect wiring or insufficient capacity of the supply wiring.
causes.ur: Wiring ghalat hai ya supply wiring ki capacity kafi nahi

solutions.en: Measure the supply under load and correct undersized wiring.
solutions.ur: Load par supply napen aur chhota size wali wiring theek karein

solutions.en: Verify stabilizer or transformer capacity for the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit ke liye stabilizer ya transformer ki capacity ki tasdeeq karein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

title.ur: Discharge gas superheat kam hona

meaning.en: Discharge gas superheat fell too low, pointing to an overfed or mis-controlled circuit.
meaning.ur: Discharge gas ki superheat bahut kam ho gayi, jo zyada charge ya ghalat control ki nishani hai

causes.en: Excessive refrigerant charge.
causes.ur: Refrigerant charge zyada hai

causes.en: Indoor expansion valve stuck open in cooling, or outdoor expansion valve stuck open in heating, or short cycling of air.
causes.ur: Cooling mein kamre wali expansion valve khuli atak gayi, ya heating mein bahar wali valve khuli atak gayi, ya hawa baar baar chal kar ruki

solutions.en: Check thermistors and wiring, then correct the refrigerant charge.
solutions.ur: Thermistors aur wiring check kar ke refrigerant charge theek karein

solutions.en: Replace or re-seat the expansion valve if it will not close.
solutions.ur: Agar expansion valve band na ho to use badal dein ya dobara lagayein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

notes.en: Same family as alarm 07 in the SET FREE / air365 series.
notes.ur: Yeh SET FREE / air365 series ke alarm 07 ka hi family hai.

title.ur: Discharge gas temperature barh gayi

meaning.en: Compressor discharge gas temperature rose above the allowed limit.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki discharge gas temperature allowed limit se upar chali gayi

causes.en: Insufficient refrigerant charge, pipe clogging or thermistor failure.
causes.ur: Refrigerant charge kam, pipe ka rakaav ya thermistor ki kharabi

causes.en: Expansion valve locked closed or piping connected incorrectly.
causes.ur: Expansion valve band h kar atak hua ya piping ghalat tareeke se connected

solutions.en: Leak test, correct the charge and clear any blockage.
solutions.ur: Leak test karein, charge theek karein aur rokawat saaf karein.

solutions.en: Replace the expansion valve or thermistor as indicated by the checks.
solutions.ur: Checks ke mutabiq expansion valve ya thermistor badal dein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

notes.en: Official Hitachi Solvers videos explain alarm 08 (compressor discharge temperature too high) for this range.
notes.ur: Official Hitachi Solvers videos is range ke liye alarm 08 (compressor discharge temperature bohat zyada) waze karte hain.

title.ur: Inlet air ke thermistor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor inlet air temperature sensor circuit is open, short or disconnected.
meaning.ur: Indoor inlet air temperature sensor ki circuit khuli, short ya disconnect hai

causes.en: Sensor disconnected, open or short circuited.
causes.ur: Sensor disconnect, khuli ya short circuit ho gaya

causes.en: Indoor PCB failure.
causes.ur: Indoor PCB kharab hai

solutions.en: Check the sensor connector and measure the sensor resistance.
solutions.ur: Sensor ka connector check karein aur us ki resistance napen

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor or the indoor PCB after testing.
solutions.ur: Test ke baad thermistor ya indoor PCB badal dein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

notes.en: Manual groups 11 to 14 under sensor on indoor unit with leading cause incorrect wiring, broken wire or short circuit.
notes.ur: Manual 11 se 14 tak ko indoor unit ka sensor kehte hain, leading cause ghalat wiring, tooti hui wire ya short circuit hai.

title.ur: DOAS remote sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The remote sensor of the DOAS fresh-air unit is open, short or disconnected.
meaning.ur: DOAS fresh air unit ka remote sensor khuli, short ya disconnect hai

causes.en: Remote sensor wiring open or short.
causes.ur: Remote sensor ki wiring khuli ya short hai

causes.en: Sensor or indoor PCB failure.
causes.ur: Sensor ya indoor PCB kharab hai

solutions.en: Check the remote sensor circuit and replace the sensor if out of specification.
solutions.ur: Remote sensor ki circuit check karein aur sensor specification se bahar ho to badal dein

solutions.en: Replace the indoor PCB if the circuit tests good.
solutions.ur: Circuit theek nikle to indoor PCB badal dein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

meaning.en: The thermistor inside the DOAS remote controller is open, short or disconnected.
meaning.ur: DOAS remote controller ke andar lage thermistor ki circuit khuli, short ya disconnect hai

causes.en: Thermistor in the controller failed.
causes.ur: Controller ka thermistor kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Connection between controller and indoor unit faulty.
causes.ur: Controller aur indoor unit ke darmiyan connection kharab hai

solutions.en: Check the controller wiring and read the sensor value.
solutions.ur: Controller ki wiring check karein aur sensor ki value parhein

solutions.en: Replace the remote controller if its sensor is out of specification.

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

title.ur: Indoor fan system ki kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor fan motor stepped out or the indoor fan controller failed.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan motor ka step out ho gaya ya indoor fan controller kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Fan motor step-out from a blocked wheel or mechanical drag.
causes.ur: Ruka hua fan ya mechanical resistance se fan motor ka step out

causes.en: Indoor fan controller failure.
causes.ur: Indoor fan controller kharab hai

solutions.en: Free the fan, check the motor and its connector.
solutions.ur: Fan ko azaad karein, motor aur us ka connector check karein

solutions.en: Replace the fan motor or controller after testing.
solutions.ur: Test ke baad fan motor ya controller badal dein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

title.ur: Indoor fan motor ki protection

meaning.en: Protection device for the indoor fan motor activated on overheat or lockup.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan motor ka protection device zyada garm ya jam hone par on ho gaya

causes.en: Fan motor overheated or seized.
causes.ur: Fan motor zyada garm ya jam ho gaya

causes.en: Restricted airflow across the indoor coil.
causes.ur: Indoor coil par hawa ka rasta band hai

solutions.en: Check airflow, filters and the fan wheel, then restart.
solutions.ur: Airflow, filters aur fan wheel check kar ke dobara chalayein

solutions.en: Replace the fan motor if it does not turn freely.
solutions.ur: Fan motor azaadi se na ghoome to badal dein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

title.en: Indoor fan controller fin temperature abnormality
title.ur: Indoor fan controller ki fin temperature ghair mamooli

meaning.en: The fan controller fin thermistor reading is abnormal or the controller is overheating.
meaning.ur: Fan controller ke fin thermistor ki reading kharabi hai ya controller zyada garm ho raha hai

causes.en: Fin thermistor faulty or heat exchanger clogged.
causes.ur: Fin thermistor kharab hai ya heat exchanger ruka hua hai

causes.en: Fan motor drawing excess current and heating the controller.
causes.ur: Fan motor zyada current le kar controller ko garam kar raha hai

solutions.en: Clean the heat exchanger and check the fin thermistor.
solutions.ur: Heat exchanger saaf karein aur fin thermistor check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the fan controller if it keeps overheating.
solutions.ur: Agar fan controller baar baar overheat kare to use badal dein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

notes.en: Cross-reference the lowercase 1a entry in the SET FREE / air365 series.
notes.ur: Cross-reference karein: SET FREE / air365 series ke chhote (lowercase) 1a entry ko.

meaning.en: Overcurrent protection tripped on the indoor fan motor.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan motor par over current protection trip ho gayi

causes.en: Fan motor winding fault or mechanical overload.
causes.ur: Fan motor ki winding kharab hai ya mechanical overload hai

causes.en: Fan controller driver fault.
causes.ur: Fan controller ka driver kharab hai

solutions.en: Check the motor insulation and that the fan turns freely.
solutions.ur: Motor ki insulation aur fan ke azaad ghoomne ki tasdeeq karein

solutions.en: Replace the fan motor or controller after testing.
solutions.ur: Test ke baad fan motor ya controller badal dein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

title.en: Indoor fan controller current sensor fault
title.ur: Indoor fan controller ka current sensor kharab

meaning.en: The current sensor of the indoor fan controller reports an abnormal value.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan controller ke current sensor ki kharabi value parh raha hai

causes.en: Fan controller current sensor failed.
causes.ur: Fan controller ka current sensor kharab hai

causes.en: Driver or motor fault producing an abnormal current signature.
causes.ur: Driver ya motor ki kharabi ki wajah se current ki reading kharabi aa rahi hai

solutions.en: Compare measured motor current with specification.
solutions.ur: Napi hui motor current ko specification se compare karein

solutions.en: Replace the fan controller or motor as indicated.
solutions.ur: Jaisa mutabiq ho fan controller ya motor badal dein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

title.ur: Indoor fan controller ki protection

meaning.en: The fan controller stopped after detecting a driver error or instantaneous overcurrent.
meaning.ur: Fan controller ne driver error ya achanak overcurrent detect kar ke khud ruka

causes.en: Driver IC error signal from overcurrent, undervoltage or short circuit.
causes.ur: Overcurrent, undervoltage ya short circuit se driver IC ka error signal

causes.ur: Fan motor ya controller ka hardware failure

solutions.en: Check the fan motor and connector for shorts.
solutions.ur: Fan motor aur connector ko short ke liye check karein

solutions.en: Replace the fan controller if the fault returns.
solutions.ur: Agar kharabi wapas aaye to fan controller badal dein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

solutions.ur: Unit ke parameters dobara load karein aur alarm clear karein

solutions.ur: Data theek na rahe to board badal dein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

title.en: Indoor unit and remote control combination error
title.ur: Indoor unit aur remote control ka ghalat combination

meaning.en: The indoor unit is paired with an incompatible remote control switch.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit aise remote control switch se jora gaya hai jo us ke mutabiq nahi

causes.en: Wrong combination of indoor unit and remote control switch.
causes.ur: Indoor unit aur remote control switch ka ghalat combination

causes.en: Controller changed without re-checking compatibility.
causes.ur: Compatibility dobara check kiye bagair controller badal diya gaya.

solutions.en: Confirm the supported remote for the unit model.
solutions.ur: Unit model ke liye supported remote ki tasdeiq karein

solutions.en: Fit the correct remote or update the unit setting.
solutions.ur: Sahi remote lagayein ya unit ki setting update karein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

notes.en: New in this service-manual generation, absent from the SET FREE / air365 table used earlier in this file.
notes.ur: Is service-manual generation mein naya code hai; is file mein phele wali SET FREE / air365 table mein maujood nahi.

title.ur: Indoor unit number ki setting mein ghalti

meaning.en: Too many indoor units are connected to one system for the addressing scheme.
meaning.ur: Addressing scheme ke liye aik system par bohat zyada indoor units jude huay hain

causes.en: 17 or more non H-LINK II units connected to one system.
causes.ur: Aik system par 17 ya zyada non H-LINK II units connected hain

causes.en: Unit numbers assigned beyond the allowed range.
causes.ur: Allowed range se bahar unit numbers de diye gaye hain

solutions.en: Split the system or re-address units within the allowed range.
solutions.ur: System ko taqseem karein ya units ko allowed range mein dobara address karein

solutions.en: Check the H-LINK topology against the design.
solutions.ur: H-LINK topology ko design ke mutabiq check karein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

notes.en: A third-party Hitachi code page also documents B5 with this meaning.
notes.ur: Teesri party ki Hitachi code page par bhi B5 isi meaning ke saath documented hai.

title.en: Indoor PCB to fan controller communication fault
title.ur: Indoor PCB se fan controller ki communication kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor board cannot communicate with the indoor fan controller.
meaning.ur: Indoor board indoor fan controller se baat nahi kar pa raha

causes.en: Communication failure between the boards.
causes.ur: Boards ke darmiyan communication nakaam hai

causes.en: Communication cable disconnected or abnormally connected.
causes.ur: Communication cable disconnect ho gayi ya ghalat tareeke se lagi hai

solutions.en: Check and re-seat the communication cable.
solutions.ur: Communication cable check kar ke dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Replace the indoor PCB or fan controller if the link stays down.
solutions.ur: Rabta barqar na rahe to indoor PCB ya fan controller badal dein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

title.ur: Do fan board ki transmission kharabi

meaning.en: Transmission between the indoor board and the two-fan PCB is abnormal.
meaning.ur: Indoor board aur do fan PCB ke darmiyan transmission kharabi hai

causes.en: Link between indoor and the two-fan PCB broken.
causes.ur: Indoor aur do fan PCB ka rabta toota hua hai

causes.en: Fan PCB or wiring failure.
causes.ur: Fan PCB ya wiring kharab hai

solutions.en: Check the connection harness between the boards.
solutions.ur: Do board ke darmiyan connection harness check karein

solutions.en: Replace the two-fan PCB if the link stays down.
solutions.ur: Agar link bar bar girta rahe to do fan wali PCB badal dein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

notes.en: Dual-fan indoor models only.
notes.ur: Sirf dual-fan indoor models ke liye hai.

title.ur: Sub-PCB ki tadad ghalat hai

meaning.en: The number of connected sub-PCBs is wrong.
meaning.ur: Connected sub-PCBs ki tadad ghalat hai

causes.en: Sub-PCB missing or an extra board detected.
causes.ur: Sub PCB mojood nahi ya aik azaf board detect ho gaya

causes.en: Wiring or detection fault on the expansion boards.
causes.ur: Expansion boards par wiring ya detection ki kharabi

solutions.en: Count the installed sub-PCBs and check their connectors.
solutions.ur: Lagaye huay sub PCB ki tadaad ginen aur un ke connectors check karein

solutions.en: Correct the hardware fitment and clear the alarm.
solutions.ur: Hardware ki fitting theek karein aur alarm clear karein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

notes.en: New in this service-manual generation, absent from the SET FREE / air365 table used earlier in this file.
notes.ur: Is service-manual generation mein naya code hai; is file mein phele wali SET FREE / air365 table mein maujood nahi.

title.ur: Compressor protection lock ho gaya

meaning.en: The system locked out after repeat compressor-related alarms and this alarm cannot be cleared from the wired controller.
meaning.ur: Compressor se juray huay alarms baar baar aane par system lock ho gaya, aur yeh alarm wired controller se clear nahi hota

causes.en: Alarms 02, 07, 08, 39, 43, 44, 45 or 47 occurred three times within six hours.
causes.ur: 6 ghante mein 02, 07, 08, 39, 43, 44, 45 ya 47 alarm teen bar a chuke hain

causes.en: An unresolved protection condition keeps re-triggering.
causes.ur: Jis ki wajah pata nahi chali protection baar baar dobara trigger ho rahi hai

solutions.en: Find and clear the underlying protection cause before resetting.
solutions.ur: Reset se pehle asal protection ki wajah dhoond kar theek karein

solutions.en: Replace the faulty outdoor component that keeps tripping the alarm.
solutions.ur: Alarm ko baar baar trip karne wala kharab outdoor hissa badal dein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

notes.en: Trigger list in this manual is 02, 07, 08, 39, 43 to 45 and 47; the SET FREE / air365 table in this file lists 02, 07, 08, 45 and 47 only.
notes.ur: Is manual ki trigger list 02, 07, 08, 39, 43 se 45 aur 47 hai; is file ki SET FREE / air365 table sirf 02, 07, 08, 45 aur 47 leti hai.
